candidate.original_question: According to the passage, what happens if he ceases to be a member of the House of the People?
candidate.proposed_question: Under Article 94(a), what happens to a Speaker's or Deputy Speaker's office if the member ceases to be a member of the House of the People?
candidate.proposed_answer: A member holding office as Speaker or Deputy Speaker shall vacate that office if the member ceases to be a member of the House of the People.
candidate.source_text_finding: Article 94(a) states a Speaker/Deputy Speaker of the House of the People shall vacate office if ceasing to be a member of that House.
candidate.quality_or_scope_flags: Question/answer are supported by the clause; answer uses gender-neutral phrasing without altering the condition.
